cover_v1: Editorial book cover photograph. A confident Nigerian woman in her forties and a Nigerian man in his fifties, chest up, side by side, looking straight into the lens, calm and healthy rather than posed or triumphant. Ankara and a plain shirt. In front of them on a wooden table: ugu leaves, garden egg, pawpaw, oranges, tomatoes, a jug of dark red zobo and a tailor's tape measure. Soft border of green leaves around the outer edge. Warm cream background, clean and uncluttered, top third left clear for typography.
plate_real: Overhead photograph of a single white plate on a wooden table, divided visibly: half the plate dark green Nigerian vegetable soup with ugu and waterleaf, a quarter grilled mackerel, a quarter a small neat ball of eba. Natural daylight, honest home kitchen, nothing styled to look imported.
plate_before: Overhead photograph of a typical Nigerian plate: a very large mound of eba taking three quarters of the plate, a small smear of soup at the edge and one small piece of meat. Same plate, same table and same light as the balanced version, so the two can sit side by side.
market: A Nigerian woman choosing ugu, okra and garden egg at an open-air market stall, early morning light, baskets of tomato and pepper behind her. Documentary, not staged.
bottles: Still life on a plain surface: three bottles of malt and soft drink on the left, a jug of dark unsweetened zobo and a bottle of water on the right, with a small heap of sugar cubes beside the bottles on the left. Clean, graphic, strong daylight.
oil: Two small bowls side by side on a wooden board: one holding a single measured tablespoon of red palm oil, the other holding a full small cup of it. Overhead, natural light, no styling.
walking: A Nigerian woman in her forties walking briskly along a quiet residential street at dawn, ordinary clothes and ordinary shoes, no gym wear, no equipment.
wall_squat: A Nigerian man in his fifties holding a wall squat against a plain interior wall at home, knees bent to a right angle, ordinary clothes, calm expression. Nothing that looks like a gym.
bag_kit: Flat lay of a work bag with its contents beside it: a small bag of unsalted roasted groundnut, two boiled eggs, an orange, a water bottle. Plain surface, daylight.
moi_moi: Overhead photograph of moi moi wrapped in leaves, unwrapped on a plate with sliced boiled egg visible, beside a bowl of pap. Home kitchen, honest, not restaurant-styled.
family_kitchen: A Nigerian family of four eating the same meal together at a table at home, the food clearly the balanced plate from this book. Warm evening light, natural, nobody posing.
